name: Finance / Money Map
annotation: HIFI-30 · /money-map · dark shell #0A0A0F + top-center amber radial glow rgba(255,94,0,.18) + 3-4% grain. Spend-by-category donut is the singular focal moment beneath a purple-glow CIAInsightCard; budgets/transactions/savings stay quiet on SolidCard surfaces (solid where dense, one glow per card). GlassCard r28, purple 7F24FF left border glow. Headline: 'Dining spend rose during high *stress*.' (stress in Newsreader Medium Italic). Tags: '[finance]' '[stress]' (domain chips 16% bg). Right: 'ask CIA' BtnGhost pill. Long-press opens insight sources.

trustControls: ChipProvenance 'via Finance API' on all real monetary metrics (donut total, savings goal).
Source chips include category, source, scope, freshness, retention, export, revoke, and delete on money or billing data.
Long-press CIA card opens source and confidence sheet.
Receipt OCR suggestion requires user confirm of merchant, category, and amount before logging.
Route locked to /money-map; no alternate vanity routes.
notes: States — Skeleton: donut ring, KPI blocks, row silhouettes, and chart axes shimmer without values. Empty: KPIs read $0 with dash deltas, donut renders a ghost outline, budget-creation chips visible. Error: section-level failure with cached safe content underneath, never a full-screen finance error. Success: transaction/budget save triggers a quiet green sweep and optional '+40 XP · Finance' toast. Disabled: swipe-to-delete and receipt scan disabled offline unless a local queue exists. Motion — Donut draws largest-to-smallest on load (reduced motion renders instant); tapping a slice cross-highlights the matching budget row. Trend scrub (long-press) shows exact day amount and source. FAB tap opens action sheet; long-press expands add/scan mini-actions. Pending/low-confidence rows reduce opacity and label 'pending' or 'estimated · low confidence'. Corrections from the draft packet: (1) Budgets card surface corrected from GlassCard to SolidCard #211008 per the spec's Components list ('SolidCard: Budgets, transactions, savings, and trend chart.') and the glass-selective rule (dense lists use solid surfaces). (2) 'ask CIA' corrected from 'BtnPrimary ghost' to BtnGhost pill so the FAB remains the screen's one primary CTA, per Focal Hierarchy ('secondary actions stay as ghost pills or row actions'). (3) Confirmed italicWord is 'stress' (the word actually italicized in the Final Composition CIA headline), not 'money' — the Visual System line's '*money*' is boilerplate pulled from the filename (same pattern confirmed in sibling specs, e.g. 26/28 read '*dashboard*', 07 reads '*conversation*').
